blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Do vision models encode the transition $2{\to}3$ the same way whether it appears in handwritten digits or in hand gestures, and do they "understand" that clean${\to}$dirty is the same transformation regardless of whether it is applied to a kitchen or a carpet? The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) answers this for language models: concept changes correspond to directions in (language) embedding space. In vision, the same concept can manifest in visually unrelated "regimes" that rarely co-occur: images of digits and hands do not share much in common in pixel space. To understand whether vision models still encode the underlying abstract concepts, we study 46 vision encoders across architectures, training objectives, and scales, on 10 concept families including numerosity, age, object identity, and MIT-States attributes. Within each regime, we find statistically significant concept directions near-universally across our tested models. However, two distinct regimes do not always share the same concept direction. Several models learn multiple linear structures for the same concept transition, split across regimes. We call this phenomenon "fragmented linearity": strong local linearity coexisting with near-absent global linearity. Fragmentation is, however, not fixed: models with stronger local linearity progressively escape it (local-global linearity correlated with $τ\in [0.38, 0.89]$ across all concepts), and where global linearity does emerge, concept directions can transfer as linear probes across regimes.
blocks.zh: 视线模型是否以同样的方式编码转换2美元到3美元, 无论是在手写数字还是手动手势中出现, 他们是否"理解"干净的$$to}$dirty是相同的转换, 不管它是适用于厨房还是地毯? 线性表示假说(LRH)为语言模型解答了这一点:概念变化对应(语言)嵌入空间的方向. 在视觉中,同样的概念可以表现在视觉上无关的"regimes"中,这些"regimes"很少被同化:数字和手的图像在像素空间中并没有什么共同点. 为了了解视觉模型是否仍然将基本的抽象概念编码,我们研究了46个视觉编码器,它们跨越建筑、培训目标和尺度,涉及10个概念家庭,包括数字、年龄、对象身份和麻省理工学院国家属性。 在每一个制度内,我们发现,在我们所测试的模型中,统计上重要的概念方向几乎是普遍的。 然而,两个不同的制度并不总是具有相同的概念方向。 一些模型为同一个概念过渡学习多条线性结构,在制度之间分化. 我们称这一现象为"分界线":强烈的地方分界线与近乎相去甚远的全球分界线共存. 然而,不成体系并不是固定的:地方线性较强的模型逐渐脱离(地方-全球线性在所有概念上与美元相关联[0.38,0.89]),在全球线性出现的地方,概念方向可以作为跨制度的线性探针来转移。

blocks.en:
The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) [ 1 , 2 ] claims that the embedding spaces of large language models (LLMs) contain linear directions corresponding to high-level concept changes, enabling interpretability and algebraic interventions in representation space.
Yet as vision encoders increasingly serve as the perceptual backbone of multimodal systems [ 3 , 4 ] , understanding whether the same linear structure holds in vision is essential to completing the picture.
blocks.zh:
线性表示假说(LRH)[1,2]声称,大语言模型(LLMS)的嵌入空间包含与高级概念变化相对应的线性方向,能够解释和代数干涉表示空间.
然而,随着视觉编码器日益成为多式联运系统[3、4]的感知中枢,理解视觉中是否具有同样的线性结构对于完成画面至关重要。

blocks.en:
Vision is fundamentally different from language in that the same concept often manifests in visually drastically different ways.
For instance, the concept of “3” can be represented using handwritten digits [ 5 ] , the number of objects in an image [ 6 ] or hand gestures [ 7 ] . While these different groups ( regimes ) of images do not share much in common in pixel space, a human would understand that the same underlying concept is being manipulated; do vision embedding spaces encode the same abstractions? A linear representation in embedding space would hint that they do.
blocks.zh:
愿景与语言根本不同,因为同一概念往往以视觉上截然不同的方式表现出来。
例如,“3”的概念可以用手写数字[5]、图像中物体的数目[6]或手势[7]来表示。 虽然图像的这些不同的组(制度)在像素空间中并没有什么共同之处,但人类会明白同样的基本概念正在被操纵;视觉嵌入空间是否编码同样的抽象? 嵌入空间中的线性表示会暗示它们这样做。

blocks.en:
Linear structure ( linearity ) in the embedding space is indeed often an assumption (implicit or otherwise) in prior works that attempt to interpret vision embeddings [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
Prior work has also studied linearity of vision embeddings after projection onto a tangent space [ 11 ] , with respect to ordinal attributes [ 12 ] , and its emergence as a consequence of data diversity [ 13 ] .
While these findings hint toward the presence of linear structure in vision embeddings, a more rigorous study exploring whether it survives across drastically unrelated visual regimes remains missing.
blocks.zh:
嵌入空间中的线性结构(线性)在试图解释嵌入视觉[8,9,10]的前作中确实经常是一种假设(隐含或其他).
先前的工作还研究了投影后嵌入正切空间的视觉线性,关于正切属性[12],以及数据多样性[13]的结果。
虽然这些发现暗示了在视觉嵌入中存在线性结构,但是仍然缺少一项更严格的研究,探讨它是否在极不相关的视觉系统中生存。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we study 46 vision encoders varying in architecture, training objective, model size and pretraining data, using the concepts of numerosity, age, and object identity, as well as 7 7 attributes curated from MIT-States [ 14 ] . We show that within a given regime, concepts are almost universally encoded linearly to an extent that is statistically distinguishable from a random baseline. However, this applies only partially to cross-regime transfer ( Figure 1 ). This finding motivates our definitions of local (within-regime), global (cross-regime) and fragmented (only within-regime without cross-regime) linearity.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们研究了46个在建筑、培训目标、模型大小和预培训数据方面各不相同的愿景编码器,它们使用了数字、年龄和对象身份等概念,以及来自麻省理工学院-州[14]的7个属性。 我们显示,在一个特定制度内,概念几乎普遍线性地编码,其程度在统计上与随机基线有区别。 然而,这只部分适用于跨制度转让(图1)。 这一发现激发了我们对地方(制度内),全球(跨制度)和分散(只有制度内没有跨制度)的分界线性的定义.

blocks.en: While local linearity is present even in supervised models with complete fragmentation across regimes (supervised models), models with stronger local linearity (CLIP-like models) also tend to exhibit stronger global linearity. This suggests a gradual convergence of regime-specific representations into abstract regime-invariant ones.
blocks.zh: 虽然地方线性甚至存在于各制度完全分散的受监督模型(受监督模型)中,但具有较强地方线性(类似CLIP模型)的模型也往往显示出较强的全球线性。 这表明,针对具体制度的表述将逐步与抽象的、无变动的制度表述统一起来。

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. A systematic investigation of the LRH for vision models. 2. Statistically rigorous empirical evidence that abstract concepts exhibit fragmented linearity . 3. Empirical evidence that modern vision encoders exhibit increasingly globally linear concept directions.

blocks.en: 2.2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2.2 有关工作

blocks.en:
Early interpretability research pioneered by [ 8 ] assumes local linear separability of samples belonging to a concept from those not belonging to it. The assumption of concepts lying in some low-dimensional subspace is implicit [ 23 ] but not otherwise verified.
More recent works [ 24 , 9 , 10 ] train SAEs to sparsely decompose embeddings. Nevertheless, it is unclear whether SAEs recover the “true” concept directions [ 25 ] . While the goal in these works is interpretability of vision models, we focus on characterizing the geometry that enables interpretability.
blocks.zh:
由[8]开创的早期可解释性研究假设属于某个概念的样本与不属于这一概念的样本的局部线性分离. 某些低维子空间中存在的概念的假设是隐含的[23],但没有经过其他验证.
更近的作品[24,9,10] 列车SAE以稀疏的分解嵌入. 然而,还不清楚SAEs是否恢复了“真正的”概念方向[25]。 虽然这些作品的目标是视觉模型的可解释性,但我们侧重于描述能够解释性的几何特征。

blocks.en:
Linear structure in vision models. [ 26 ] discover task-aligned subspaces in CLIP’s image encoder.
Extending the findings from [ 22 ] to the vision domain, [ 11 ] show that CLIP image embeddings admit approximately linear structure after projection onto the tangent space. [ 12 ] show that many ordinal attributes can be linearly decoded from popular vision encoders, while [ 13 ] show compositional linearity emerges as a consequence of training data diversity.
blocks.zh:
视觉模型中的线性结构. [26] 在CLIP的图像编码器中发现任务对齐的子空间.
将发现从[22]扩展至视觉域,[11]显示CLIP嵌入的图像在投影到正切空间后承认了大约线性结构. [12] 显示许多正线属性可以从流行的视觉编码器中线性解码,而[13] 显示组成线性因训练数据多样性而出现.

blocks.en:
The above works assess linearity as a single global property of the representation.
In contrast, we consider visually different regimes separately and hypothesize that (1) individual regimes contain strong concept representations, and (2) linearity ( Definition 2.1 ) often holds only weakly because regime-specific concept representations fail to transfer strongly. This is also akin to learning different mechanisms for solving the same task in different contexts [ 27 ] , although mechanistic interpretability is outside our scope.
blocks.zh:
上述工作评估了代表性作为单一全球财产的线性。
相反,我们认为,不同的制度是分开的和假设的,即:(1) 个别制度载有强有力的概念表述,(2) 线性(定义2.1)往往只是薄弱的,因为针对特定制度的概念表述未能有力转移。 这也类似于在不同的环境下学习解决相同任务的不同机制[27],尽管机械解释性不在我们的范围之内.

blocks.en: VLM embedding spaces. A broad body of prior work studies different aspects of VLM embedding spaces in general. Of particular note have been the modality gap [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] , binding capabilities [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] and negation [ 34 ] . [ 35 ] propose geometric constraints for an “ideal” CLIP. In contrast to these works, our work explores the local geometry of general vision models, including CLIP.
blocks.zh: VLM 嵌入空间 。 一系列广泛的前期工作研究了VLM嵌入空间的一般不同方面. 特别值得注意的是模式差距[28、29、30]、约束能力[31、32、33]和否定[34]。 [35]为“理想的”CLIP提出几何限制。 与这些作品相比,我们的工作探索了包括CLIP在内的一般视觉模型的局部几何.

blocks.en: Compositional generalization and compositional zero-shot learning. VLMs have been frequently shown to be suitable for compositional zero-shot learning [ 36 , 37 , 38 ] , compositional retrieval [ 39 , 40 , 41 ] , and concept editing [ 42 ] . Other work has revealed shortcomings [ 43 ] . We take a complementary approach and analyze the geometry of existing vision encoders for local linearity; our findings may contribute towards explaining the compositional failures of VLMs.
blocks.zh: 组成概括和组成 零镜头学习。 VLM常被证明适合组成式零射学习[36,37,38],组成检索[39,40,41],概念编辑[42]. 其他工作暴露了缺点[43]. 我们采取了一种互补的方法,并分析现有视觉编码器的几何图案,以便实现局部线性;我们的调查结果可能有助于解释VLM的构成故障。

blocks.en: Representation convergence. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis [ 44 ] argues that learned representations are converging toward a shared, canonical model of the world. In contrast, we study a different form of convergence: whether a single model’s embedding space aligns the same concept across different regimes . Our perspective is closer to work questioning whether neural networks reuse identical computational structures across settings [ 45 , 27 , 46 ] . In contrast, however, we focus on the final-layer embeddings which are directly exposed to downstream tasks like zero-shot retrieval and classification.
blocks.zh: 代表性趋同. 《柏拉图代表假说》[44] 认为,学到的表述正在趋同于一个共同的、空洞的世界模式。 相比之下,我们研究了一种不同的趋同形式:单一模式的嵌入空间是否在不同制度之间协调同一概念。 我们的观点更接近于质疑神经网络是否在各种设置中重复使用相同的计算结构[45、27、46]。 然而,相比之下,我们侧重于直接暴露在下游任务的终层嵌入物,如零镜头检索和分类。

blocks.en: 3 Fragmented Linearity
blocks.zh: 3 分裂线性

blocks.en: This section defines local linearity and fragmentation and lays out the measurements used throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 本节界定了局部线性与支离破碎性,并列出了整个论文使用的测量方法.

blocks.en: 3.1 Regimes and approximate counterfactuals
blocks.zh: 3.1 制度和大约相反事实

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Regimes and local linearity

blocks.en:
Consider the texts “3 fingers” and “the digit 3”: in language, the shared concept “3” is explicit.
No comparable explicit signal links an image of the digit 3 to an image of three raised fingers.
Similarly, “old coin” and “old building” make the connection explicit but images of old coins and old buildings do not.
This motivates studying concept structure in vision at the level of data subsets (digits, fingers, spheres, coins, buildings, and so on), which we call regimes .
Formally, we use a partition 𝒫 = { S r } r = 1 m \mathcal{P}=\{S_{r}\}_{r=1}^{m} with S r ⊆ 𝒵 S_{r}\subseteq\mathcal{Z} and ⋃ r = 1 m S r = 𝒵 \bigcup_{r=1}^{m}S_{r}=\mathcal{Z} , and call each S r S_{r} a regime.
This allows us to study linearity within and across regimes.

同样,“旧硬币”和“旧建筑”使连接变得明确,但旧硬币和旧建筑的图像却没有。
这激发了在数据子集(数字、手指、球体、硬币、建筑等)层面对视觉概念结构的研究,我们称之为制度。

blocks.en: We describe the setup for reproducing our experiments.

blocks.en:
Our study covers 46 vision models trained using different objectives: image-text contrastive models [ 18 , 47 , 48 ] ,
DINO [ 49 , 19 , 50 ] ,
masked image modeling [ 51 ] ,
and several supervised models. We cover both CNN-based [ 52 ] and transformer-based [ 53 ] architectures.
For CNNs we use average-pooled features; for vision transformers we use the class token.
Pretrained CLIP variants are sourced from OpenCLIP [ 54 ] and all other models from timm [ 55 ] .
We provide the full list of models in Appendix A .

For MIT-States [ 14 ] , we use 7 binary attributes (brightness, cleanliness, dryness, modernness, rawness, ripeness, sunniness), with 30 images per regime-class pair and 4-10 regimes per attribute.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 46 vision models spanning contrastive, self-supervised, and supervised training objectives, on 10 concepts (numerosity, age, object identity, and seven MIT-States attributes).
For each concept, images are partitioned into regimes (e.g., MNIST digits, raised fingers, rendered spheres for numerosity).
For each model-concept pair, we compute per-regime-pair DC \mathrm{DC} , yielding regime × \times regime matrices ( Figure 2 ). Each entry in such a matrix is a measure of local linearity within that regime (diagonal entries) or global linearity across regimes (off-diagonal entries).
Full details of models and datasets are in Section 3.3 .

For more abstract concepts like numerosity and cleanliness, regimes differ in subject matter (digits, fingers, spheres), making it harder for regime-invariant directions to emerge.

blocks.en:
Our findings above indicate that concept representations in vision embeddings can be significantly locally linear yet fully fragmented across regimes ( Figure 2 , left).
While we have so far treated linearity as binary (either statistically significant or not) we now ask whether global linearity varies across models of different local linearities.
Does stronger within-regime linear structure in modern foundation models reflect deeper concept understanding, or simply stronger regime-specific biases (leading to even weaker global understanding)?

虽然我们迄今为止把线性当作二进制(无论统计学上是否重要),我们现在问全球线性是否因不同地方线性模型而异。
现代基础模型中更强有力的制度内线性结构是反映更深刻的概念理解,还是只是更强烈的针对制度的具体偏见(导致更弱的全球理解)?

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Almost all vision models encode “three”, but not all of them know it is “three”.
While vision embeddings are locally linear to the extent of statistical significance almost without exception, many of them learn the same concept several times, once per regime, reflected in the phenomenon we characterize as fragmentation. As locally linear structure gets stronger, cross-regime alignment increases and global linearity emerges, producing semantically meaningful concept directions that can act as effective linear probes. Given our characterization of vision embedding geometry, the overarching question as to whether regime-specific skills are also converging into abstract ones (and whether they are related to geometry) remains open to future work.
blocks.zh:
几乎所有的视觉模型都编码为“三”,但并非所有的模型都知道是“三”。
虽然愿景嵌入几乎无一例外地具有统计意义的局部线性,但其中许多人在若干次学习同样的概念,一次是每个制度,这反映在我们称之为不成体系的现象中。 随着本地线性结构的加强,跨监管的对齐性增强,全球线性出现,产生了具有一定意义的概念方向,可以起到有效的线性探测作用. 鉴于我们对植入几何的愿景的描述,关于制度特有的技能是否也正在融合成抽象技能(以及这些技能是否与几何相关)这一首要问题仍然对今后的工作开放。

blocks.en: Although we cover a broad range of concepts exhibiting varying degrees of difficulty, our conclusions are limited in scope to the investigated concept types. Our counterfactual pairs are approximate: matched by embedding space distance. While these limitations are unavoidable in the current scope, we argue that our statistical tests and downstream capability (probing) results together establish sufficient evidence to validate our main claims.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们涵盖各种表现出不同程度困难的概念,但我们的结论范围仅限于调查的概念类型。 我们的反事实对是近似的:配以嵌入空间距离. 虽然这些限制在目前范围内是不可避免的,但我们认为,我们的统计测试和下游能力(检验)结果共同为证实我们的主要主张提供了充分的证据。

blocks.en: Linear directions in embedding space can potentially be exploited to steer representations toward harmful outputs; our work characterizes this geometry but does not introduce new attack surfaces beyond what already exists in existing models. On the other hand, our work contributes to the literature on interpretability, which strives to make AI systems fair and transparent.
blocks.zh: 嵌入空间的线性方向可以被利用来引导表达向有害输出;我们的工作是这种几何特征的特征,但不会在现有模型中已有的范围之外引入新的攻击表面。 另一方面,我们的工作有助于关于可解释性的文献,这些文献力求使人工智能系统公平和透明。
